lane: co-training between a geophysical view and a surface view; Blum & Mitchell COLT '98, doi:10.1145/279943.279962
hypothesis: Two views that err near-independently corroborate: pixels that both the potential-field/subsurface view and the surface view vouch for, ranked by their joint confidence min(pA,pB), should carry a higher density of real, unmapped fault pixels than either view alone - the opposite cell of the 2x2 confidence table from the one every prior round in this lane shipped.
mechanism: Two independent thinnings of one detector intersect in an atom carrying 16.3-20.5% credit density against 0-8.7% for singly-selected atoms (knowledge/10 s3); Blum-Mitchell conditional independence is a strictly stronger independence than two thinnings of one field, and it measures here at max|r| = 0.176 against a 0.60 abandonment bar.
named_non_fault_processes_that_could_mim: a resistant lithologic contact (welded tuff or carbonate) that stands up as a ridge AND carries a magnetic susceptibility contrast: straight, laterally persistent, geologically real, and not a fault
a fluvial or glacial escarpment along a stratigraphic contact

holdout_dti.label: HOLDOUT-DTI

evaluator_version.metric: gems52.metric.dti (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, R 300 m triangular kernel, lattice-exact offsets)
evaluator_version.holdout: gems52.holdout.make_folds(mode=hide, n_folds=4, buffer_px=4, prevalence=0.002, seed=20261010); mask_visible pixel-exact
evaluator_version.pooling: per-fold DTI plus pooled DTI (TPw/FPw/FNw/n_truth component sums pooled across folds); fold-bootstrap 95% CI (10k resamples)
evaluator_version.known_defect: Spearman(owner-reported board score, hide-and-recover DTI) = -0.1045, p = 0.734, n = 13; the 0.2778 champion ranks 13/13 on this instrument. It is reported because the lane requires it and because it is the only instrument that can detect leakage; it is NOT a board proxy.

holdout_dti.instrument_status: the hide-and-recover instrument is reported because the lane requires it and because it is the only leakage detector available; it is NOT a board proxy (Spearman(owner-reported, simulated) = -0.1045, n = 13)

instrument2_revealed.label: revealed-preference co-location; NOT a holdout score
instrument2_revealed.limits: similarity statistic to one specific prior file; rho_P1 rests on owner-reported scores; read only together with the uniqueness gate

disagreement_read.note: the lane's designated discovery signal measured BELOW the matched random control on Instrument 2

validator_output.validation_class: local on-disk template/range check; not organizer upload acceptance

submission_note: H62 two-view co-training: conc_soft ranking, 22000 px, derived budget, >=200 m off catalogue. Research review copy.
promotion_scope: 'promote' is a verdict on the registered instrument only: it means the concordance ranking beat BOTH single-view baselines and the union on pooled hide-and-recover HOLDOUT-DTI. It does NOT mean a weekly slot is allocated, and it does NOT mean the artifact beats the surface view on the revealed-preference instrument, where it does not.
number_labels: every holdout number is HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator version, withheld positives, 95% CI); every leaderboard number anywhere in this repo is owner-reported; none is ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED (no submission-page receipt exists); a projection is never written as a score

build.winner_selection_rule: highest Instrument-2 co-location lift among candidates whose dot set overlaps clf_union's top-k by <= 70% (correction H62-3)
build.dossier_note: dossier rows are written for every A-only component of >=3 px in the legal pool; smaller components are counted in a_only_segments_total and dropped

corrections.summary: the hard corroboration intersection is structurally unusable at this budget (k^2/n = 185 at k=30,000); the soft joint-confidence ranking min(pA,pB) is registered instead

emission budget 22,000 px: the gamma fit's unclamped argmax 102,519 px lies outside the measured range, while the board's own published record (Spearman -1.000, n=6, mass vs score) is a direct measurement and governs
view_B and clf_union are disqualified as 'merely the union': their dot sets overlap by 93-100% and their reads differ by 3%

independence.negative_class: held-out catalogue-zero proxies, not verified absence
independence.reason: weak proxy negative-error correlation; not proof of conditional feature independence

leakage_canary.verdict: no single layer exceeds AUC 0.90 on the holdout; no leakage detected at this granularity

slot_decision: research review copy; promotion to a real weekly slot is a separate selector step within the cap on the submission page
